paragraphs.en: With {millions} of people likely to take on DIY projects over the {coming} weeks, new research shows that more than {half} of people are planning to make the most of the long, warm {summer} days to get jobs done.The average {spend} {per} project will be around £823. {Two} {thirds} of people aim to improve their comfort while at home.Two {fifths} wish to increase the value of their house.Though DIY has traditionally been seen as a {male} {hobby} , the research shows it is women who are now leading the charge.People craft everything from {cute} {scarf} {hangers} to {lanterns} for the garden.

paragraphs.en: Alex Gosling, the boss of online estate agency HouseSimple, warns people to recognize their DIY limitations.You might find a {leak} in the bathroom that almost ruins all your {clay} tiles ( (瓷砖) ).Or you might try to hang a {vase} , only to realize you need better support beams ( (梁) )."We're probably all capable of painting walls, but it's a big step to building an {extension} or taking load-bearing walls down."
